episode_summary: This episode explores the impact of global oil prices on mortgage rates and highlights niche loan programs for specific professions. Austin Clarence shares insights on how agents can leverage these opportunities to attract more clients and navigate current market conditions. The discussion also covers strategies for self-employed individuals to secure loans without traditional documentation.
